candidates.tagline: The truck they said would be bulletproof got 11 recalls — now it's cancelled.
candidates.story: Tesla announced on November 6, 2026 that it will end Cybertruck production in 2027 to free factory space for Cybercab robotaxis, retiring a vehicle that promised 250,000 units/year, delivered roughly 30,000, and racked up 11 safety recalls in three years.
candidates.why_funny: A truck unveiled by shattering its own supposedly indestructible windows live on stage, designed with flat steel panels no factory knew how to weld, is being cancelled to make room for robot taxis.
candidates.alt: 2024 Tesla Cybertruck Foundation Series in front-left three-quarter view at a car show, showing its angular stainless-steel wedge body and hard geometric lines

candidates.tagline: Toy giant marks 100 years with a logo that looks like a fintech wellness app.
candidates.story: On November 11, 2026, Takara Tomy announced it will replace its cheerful red TOMY wordmark with an abstract teal-to-magenta gradient symbol for its 100th anniversary global rebrand — leaving fans and design critics baffled at what an indistinct gradient has to do with toys.
candidates.why_funny: A company whose entire brand equity is built on colourful, joyful, recognisable toys — Transformers, Tamagotchi, Thomas the Tank Engine — chose a logo indistinguishable from a mindfulness startup.
candidates.alt: Side-by-side comparison of the old bold red TOMY wordmark logo and the new abstract teal-to-magenta gradient TakaraTomy symbol
